mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) as total_files, SUM(CASE WHEN file_system_status = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as pending_files, SUM(CASE WHEN file_system_status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as merging_files, SUM(CASE WHEN file_system_status = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as completed_files, SUM(CASE WHEN file_system_status = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as failed_files, SUM(CASE WHEN file_system_status = 2 THEN file_system_size ELSE 0 END) as total_size, AVG(CASE WHEN file_system_status = 2 THEN file_system_size ELSE NULL END) as avg_file_size, MAX(file_system_size) as max_file_size, MIN(CASE WHEN file_system_status = 2 THEN file_system_size ELSE NULL END) as min_file_size, COUNT(CASE WHEN DATE(create_time) = CURDATE() THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) as today_files, COUNT(CASE WHEN file_system_http_access_enabled = 1 THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) as http_access_files FROM file_system
